summary: Deliver one new D5 mathematical result as a single independently mergeable increment: its Lean F-layer formalization together with its mirroring canonical Blueprint narrative. Fully self-contained — executors need no other file.
applies_when: Conservative router: choose this only when the origin issue text unambiguously matches this flow and exactly one flow: it asks for ONE NEW D5 result delivered as a SINGLE increment: its Lean F-layer formalization together with its mirroring Blueprint narrative. Rationale embedded here so no external file is needed: this repository has a Blueprint (B) narrative plane that MIRRORS the formal (F) Lean plane's address, and Lean carries a dual role (proof + language); for a new result, the Lean file and Blueprint must be created in the same increment so each side's typed reference resolves in the combined candidate tree. Do NOT choose it for epics, trackers, broad multi-slice work, Blueprint-only or Lean-only work, multi-increment sequencing, bug fixes, refactors, contract migrations, docs-only work, spikes, or ambiguous requests; when the match is not explicit and unique, choose none/plain devloop instead.

steps.title: Formalize the result with its Blueprint narrative

content.generator:
Read the origin issue from its source_ref and emit exactly one child issue title and body for the combined formalize-with-blueprint step. Scope the child PR to ONE new D5 mathematical result, simultaneously delivering its Lean F-layer formalization and its mirroring Blueprint narrative in the SAME increment. All rules are embedded below; do NOT consult any external spec file.

ADDRESS (one math unit = one canonical address across at most three planes F/B/E). The result has one canonical formal (F-layer, Lean) address of the form `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>`, where the F-layer GID equals the literal repository path minus the `.lean` suffix. Repository top level is `Metallic/ + D5/ + Moduli/`. D5 strata: S0 = Carrier/Conventions; S1 = Scale/Digit/Phase/Depth; S2 = Word/Lattice/ModelSet/IFS/Pzg; S3 = Arith/Diffraction/Spectral/Analytic/Solenoid/Fractal; S4 = KTheory/Hecke/PhysicsDict. Special zones: open problems under `X_Frontier/`, named assumptions under `X_Assumptions/`, conditional theorems under `X_Certificates/`. Formalize at the F-layer path `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.lean` — F is the ONLY load-bearing plane (definitions/theorems/proofs live here; narrative/numerics/commentary never bear weight). One file = one main concept; file name is `CamelCase.lean`; file length <= 400 lines. MIRROR LAW: the Blueprint (B) plane does not own its own taxonomy — it BORROWS the F-layer address. The Blueprint artifact therefore lives at `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>` mirroring the chosen F address. For this new result, that F address MUST be created in this same child PR, not treated as a dangling FUTURE address.

ATOMIC DELIVERABLE / MIRROR CONSISTENCY. The single child increment MUST create both `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.lean` and its Blueprint pair `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.scribe.cs` plus `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.md`. The Lean six-line header's `mirror-B` MUST name `D5/B/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>`, while the Blueprint document header's formal GID MUST name `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>` and resolve to the new `.lean` file in this same PR. Both directions must agree from the start and validators must inspect the combined candidate tree; neither half may be deferred to a predecessor or later increment.

SCRIBE DELIVERABLE (document-as-code). The canonical source of a Blueprint document is a typed C# document definition — a `*.scribe.cs` file authored under `Blueprint/` mirroring the F address, e.g. `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.scribe.cs`. Its header/sections/paragraphs/formulas and GID references are a typed AST; GID references are resolved at construction time and MUST NOT dangle. From that typed definition, deterministically emit the Markdown projection at `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.md`. The Markdown is a BUILD PROJECTION, not a hand-edited file: it must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to the canonical writer's output. Content: state the definition or theorem statement and the proof idea in narrative form.

MANDATORY SIX-LINE LEAN FILE HEADER (exact shape; status is derived from it, never hand-written):
/- GID: D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>
   generality: G|I|E
   mirror-B: D5/B/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>
   mirror-E: D5/E/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.result--json | none(waiver:<reason>)
   anchors: []
   digest: <one-line human summary> -/
ANCHORS: for a theory-volume formalization use `anchors: []`. The Scribe anchor parser accepts EXACTLY two schemes — `lit/<bibkey>` (a genuine literature citation backed by a Library note) and `mathlib/{module,decl}/<Lean.Qualified.Name>` (a real mathlib dependency reference) — and it REJECTS every other scheme at admission. Do NOT emit a `gict`, `pzg`, or `spec` anchor: those theory-provenance schemes are NOT implemented by the parser, so a header carrying one is un-admittable (this exact mistake — an emitted `anchors: [pzg/proposition/N]` — has repeatedly deadlocked consensus and killed the atom). The origin atom's theory provenance (its source id and location in the theory volume) is recorded downstream via `coverage_gids` in the Digestion Ledger (`Meta/BACKFILL.yaml`) once the formalization merges — NEVER as a Scribe anchor. Each anchor is ASCII, ordinal, strict round-trip (no loose normalization).

STATUS IS SYNTAX (machine-derived; hand-writing a status is forbidden): (a) NO `sorry` AND axiom closure subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} => PROVED; (b) axiom closure includes an axiom registered in AxiomDebt.lean => AXIOM-CARRYING; (c) a declaration signature carrying `(h : Assumptions.X)` => CONDITIONAL THEOREM (certificate, lives under X_Certificates/); (d) residing under `X_Frontier/` with `sorry` => OPEN. Unregistered extra axioms are rejected. Mathlib's three standard axioms are the accepted base.

LEAN'S DUAL ROLE: proof (no sorry = proved) AND language (a Frontier `sorry` is a FORMALLY REPRESENTED unknown, not a verified truth). Therefore `sorry` is allowed ONLY under `X_Frontier/`; anywhere else it is a violation.

BUILD/AXIOM GATE: `lake build` must be green; NO private or unregistered axioms.

PREREQUISITES & CONTEXT (a theory atom is NOT self-contained — its statement and proof reference results and notions defined elsewhere, so `atom_text` alone is insufficient): before writing the Lean, identify every prerequisite the atom depends on — cited theorems/propositions/lemmas (e.g. `定理 6.7`, `命题 9.1`) AND named notions/operators/functions used without inline definition (e.g. `β′`, a specific window or topology). For each prerequisite, SEARCH the existing formalized library: grep `D5/` for a matching Lean declaration and check `Meta/BACKFILL.yaml` `coverage_gids` for the corresponding source atom. If it is already formalized, IMPORT and reference that existing Lean declaration/GID rather than re-deriving it. If a prerequisite is genuinely elementary and self-contained you MAY inline a minimal proof. But if the atom depends on a SUBSTANTIAL prerequisite that is NOT yet formalized (no matching D5 declaration; its source atom still `coverage_gids: []`), do NOT fabricate an undefined notion or a hand-waved stand-in — instead produce NO changes with a clear WHY naming the missing prerequisite(s) and their source atom (e.g. `missing prerequisite: pzg theorem/6.7 (window length) not yet formalized`), so the origin is deferred and its prerequisite is formalized first rather than deadlocking consensus on an undefined term. This is honest well-founded dependency handling (CLAUDE.md 第〇/2条), not a weakening of the claim.

VALIDATE the complete single increment: emitted Markdown is byte-identical to the canonical writer output; narrative is internally consistent; every typed GID reference resolves with no dangling reference, including the Blueprint formal GID resolving to the new Lean file; Lean `mirror-B` and Blueprint formal GID are mutually consistent; `lake build` is green; and no private or unregistered axiom is present.

Keep the Lean file and its Blueprint `.scribe.cs` plus emitted `.md` as ONE independently mergeable increment. Do NOT ask the child to duplicate devloop consensus, CI, PR review, or merge gates; devloop provides those. If no mergeable combined formalization-and-narrative increment exists, the child must produce NO changes with a clear WHY; no-changes is fatal and blocks the origin.
